ns2:section.sectionText: This section is particularly aimed at students who were in a C2M (Merit) section of Math 347; for secondary education students; and for Math majors who were previous participants in the Merit Workshop program, but is now open to all math majors. This section only has Math 347 as a prerequisite, not Math 416. Students considering graduate school in Mathematics should consider a different section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Mathematics major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
